events.quote: on 14 June 2024, the Group entered into a five-year $3.0 billion, sustainability-linked, secured Revolving Credit Facility, with two one-year extension options available subject to the approval of lenders, accessible by British Airways, Iberia and Aer Lingus, each of which has separate limits. At 31 December 2024 no amounts had been drawn under the facility.
events.summary: The Group entered into a new sustainability-linked secured revolving credit facility and extinguished its previous secured revolving credit facility and British Airways' export development guarantee facilities.
events.title: New sustainability-linked revolving credit facility replaces older facilities

events.quote: We are investment grade with Moody’s and S&P, both of which upgraded IAG during the year.
events.summary: The Group states it is investment grade with Moody's and S&P, both of which upgraded IAG during the year.
events.title: Credit ratings upgraded to investment grade by agencies

events.quote: The Group continues to be impacted by reliability and performance issues with Rolls-Royce Trent 1000 and Pratt and Whitney GTF engines, which are mitigated by using replacement aircraft and invoking remedy support from the engine manufacturers.
events.summary: The Group continues to be impacted by reliability and performance issues with Rolls-Royce Trent 1000 and Pratt and Whitney GTF engines, mitigated by replacement aircraft and remedy support from manufacturers, while capital expenditure was lower due to aircraft delivery delays.
events.title: Engine reliability issues and aircraft delivery delays

events.quote: The Irish Aviation Authority (IAA) aimed to impose a passenger cap at Dublin Airport, but Aer Lingus and other airlines legally challenged the decision. In November the High Court granted a stay on capping take-off and landing slots for the summer 2025 season, and the case has now been referred to the ECJ.
events.summary: The Irish Aviation Authority aimed to impose a passenger cap at Dublin Airport, Aer Lingus and other airlines legally challenged it, and the High Court granted a stay on capping take-off and landing slots for the summer 2025 season.
events.title: Dublin Airport passenger cap challenged and stayed

events.quote: In 2024, the Spanish Ministry of Consumer Affairs sanctioned Vueling and another four airlines for hand luggage policy. The case is under judicial review as it allegedly breaches EU pricing freedom and distorts competition in the single market.
events.summary: The Spanish Ministry of Consumer Affairs sanctioned Vueling and other airlines for hand luggage policy, and the case is under judicial review.
events.title: Spanish consumer authority sanctions Vueling over hand luggage policy

events.quote: The signing of the fourth collective bargaining agreement for pilots also marks a significant step in securing sustainable agreements across all our labour groups.
events.summary: The signing of the fourth collective bargaining agreement for pilots is described as a significant step in securing sustainable agreements across all labour groups.
events.title: Fourth collective bargaining agreement signed for pilots
